address: Bang-Ain Road, Tha Wasukri, Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya, 13000, Thailand
bio: This third-generation family-run street food joint has been offering tasty boat noodles for over five decades. Their experience shines through in the delicious broth, well-balanced in flavours. Try their pork or beef boat noodles for great value, or consider the recommended dry tom yum-style egg noodles with pork. The friendly owners' hospitality attracts a bustling lunch crowd....
